author: musho7-dev
subject: Online rooms: create or join a room, the host starts the race
body:
- Room list with JOIN (shows players, racing, full) and CREATE ROOM
- Inside a room: players with a HOST tag; only the host can START RACE (2+ players)
- After a race everyone goes back to the same room; if the host leaves, the next player hosts
- Past the finish line your car parks and can't move until the race is over
- Robots: --name, --car and --join=<host> to fill a friend's room; --hostbot hosts a room
- Test option --port=N for a second server
